Sam (CEO): Quick weekly note — high level priorities for next 7 days:
1) Dedicated launch next Wed (region eu-west-1) — full rollout plan linked below. Please treat this as our top cross-functional priority. :rocket:
2) New default data retention policy for dev/oss projects: logs and request traces will be retained 30 days (Enterprise customers unchanged). Rolling policy live Friday, opt-out via support ticket for approved cases.
3) Incident follow-up: last Tuesday’s degraded serving for hosted—fallbacks worked but latency spiked. We’ll share the postmortem draft tomorrow.
4) Metrics: p95 gen latency down ~12% month-over-month, infra unit cost down ~6% after batching tweaks. Nice work.
5) Ops note: freeze on model metadata changes for public models until end of day Friday; exceptions must be approved by @Anya.

Anya (VP Product): Adding details — canary window for dedicated launch is 10:00–12:00 UTC Wed. Teams owning routes A/B/C (search, chat, embeddings) please validate metrics in staging by Tue EOD. If you need extra capacity for smoke tests, ping @Miguel. Link to rollout doc: https://internal.redwood/rollouts/dedicated-euw

Miguel (Head of Ops): Quick incident summary for context — root cause was a scheduler race when autoscaler reclaimed nodes during KV cache warmup. Impact: increased p95 for ~27m, some requests served by warm fallback model causing higher cost but degraded latency only. Mitigation deployed (serialized drain + short delay) and autoscaler changed to prefer draining instead of immediate eviction. Postmortem meeting scheduled Thu 14:00 UTC in #incidents.

Rita (SRE Lead): Follow-ups — Dedicated customers with strict latency SLOs were on the fallback policy; we executed SLA credits where applicable. Next steps: adding an observability alert for rapid cache-warmup failures and a small change to our drain hook. Will open PRs today. @eng-oncall please review the playbook update.

Jo (People Ops): Heads up — we’ll do a short town hall Thur 11:00 UTC to walk through the new retention policy and answer questions. Recording and FAQ to follow. If your team needs tailored retention settings, coordinate with Sales/CS and file the template form by Fri EOD.

announce-bot: Scheduled deploy for dedicated rollout is set for 2026-04-01T10:00:00Z. Notifying stakeholders and triggering canary health checks.

Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone — two asks before EOD Monday: (1) Product to post a short checklist in #eng-releases with exact regression/signoff criteria; (2) Ops to validate rollback playbook with a dry run. I’ll join the Thu postmortem. :thumbsup:

Anya (VP Product): Will do. I’ll drop the checklist in #eng-releases and DM owners for signoffs.

Miguel (Head of Ops): Rolling schedule for dry run created, pinging oncall now.

Rita (SRE Lead): On it — will run dry run Tue 03:00 UTC (non-peak) and report results.

Jo (People Ops): Town hall invite sent. :calendar:

Sam (CEO): Appreciate it — big week. Let's keep comms tight and escalate early. :eyes:
